company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration to help teams build and manage APIs. The platform allows engineers and organizations to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services at enterprise scale.
target_audience: Developers, engineers, and enterprise organizations building, testing, and managing APIs.
leadership: Abhinav Asthana (CEO and co-founder); Ankit Sobti (Founder); Abhijit Kane (Founder)

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform designed for developers to build and scale applications. It provides a dedicated Postgres database alongside built-in authentication, realtime data, storage, RESTful APIs, edge functions, and vector embeddings.
target_audience: Developers and software engineering teams looking for a scalable, open-source backend development platform powered by Postgres.
leadership: Paul Copplestone; Ant Wilson; Tracy Lane (General Counsel)

company_overview: Vapi provides a developer-first platform and real-time audio infrastructure for building, testing, and deploying enterprise voice AI agents. The platform handles orchestration, low-latency telephony, model integrations, and conversation guardrails to help organizations automate calls at scale.
target_audience: Developers and enterprise teams seeking to build, deploy, and scale real-time conversational voice AI agents.
